Giroud Returns to Arsenal Stadium with Lille in Champions League

Olivier Giroud, formerly of Arsenal, is set to return to the stadium where he played for the club. He will be playing for Lille in a Champions League match against Arsenal. Giroud had previously left Arsenal to join Chelsea after a conversation with his then-manager.
